title: Build a serverless PII redaction pipeline with Amazon Bedrock Data Automation
summary: Learn how to automate end-to-end PII detection and redaction from scanned documents at scale using Amazon Bedrock Data Automation with a custom blueprint, AWS Step Functions, and AWS Lambda. A custom blueprint redacts sensitive fields with field-level precision, and a token match
